verdict.rationale: HeyGen is a SaaS video platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question. Its docs say every endpoint ships with an MCP server that Claude, Cursor, and other agents can use. They also describe connecting video generation to any MCP-compatible agent with no API keys, no local server, and no separate credits, and a probe confirms a dedicated MCP overview page at developers.heygen.com/mcp/overview. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually connect and run tools successfully, and detail on the exposed tool set and auth flow.
